Marcos Gonzales

I'm Marcos Gonzales, founder of Peak Workflow Solutions, a Washington-registered automation practice built to bring real AI systems to Yakima Valley businesses, without the big-agency price tag or an out-of-state account manager reading from a script.

My own background spans hospitality, beauty, trades and construction, home services, and food, the service industry, which is where I specialize. I've worked inside these businesses, not just sold to them, and that's exactly why I value the relationships they run on. I'm using that firsthand knowledge to help business owners spend more time doing the creative work they love, the craft, the client, the job itself, and less time buried in the busywork behind it.

In practice, that means building automation workflow systems: lead capture & follow-up, bid & project intake, daily execution planning, plus clean, fast websites like this one that tie it all together.

Work with me directly. No support queue, no account manager relaying your request. The person who builds your system is the person who answers when you call.

Common Questions

Before you book a call

The stuff most people ask before they're ready to pull the trigger.

What exactly do you build?

Custom automation systems for your specific business — lead capture and follow-up so no inquiry gets missed, bid and project intake, daily execution planning, and AI agents that handle the busywork in between. Not a generic tool; it's built around how you actually work.

How is this different from just buying software?

Off-the-shelf software makes you adapt your process to fit it. I build the system to fit your process instead, and I'm the one who sets it up, tests it, and keeps it running — not a subscription you're left to configure alone.

What does it cost?

It depends on what we build — a simple lead-capture form and a full multi-step planning system aren't priced the same. The free audit is where we figure out what you actually need and what it runs, no cost or obligation to move forward.

How long before something's actually live?

No multi-month agency timeline. After the free audit, I design the system, build it, and test it against your own real data before it ever goes live — most builds move in days to a couple weeks, not quarters.

Do I have to replace the tools I already use?

No — the systems are built to work with what you've already got, whether that's Gmail, Google Sheets, Notion, QuickBooks, or your phone. The goal is connecting your tools, not ripping them out.

What happens if something breaks after it's live?

You call or text me directly. No support ticket, no account manager relaying your request to someone else — the person who built your system is the person who answers.

Ready for a workflow built around how you actually work?

A free audit takes 20 minutes and costs nothing — you'll walk away with a clear map of where automation actually helps.

I read every one myself — no spam, ever.
